## ADR-0017 Compliance Checklist (required for protocol, crypto, privacy, and architecture changes)

This checklist supplements the repository's primary PR template. Complete it when a change affects architecture, protocol, crypto, privacy, or governance.

- ADRs referenced: ___________
- Is the change formally verifiable? (Y/N) If Y, link the proof/plan: _________
- Privacy budget impacted? (Y/N). If Y, provide metrics and mitigation: _______
- Are cryptographic primitives modular and versioned? (Y/N)
- Does this introduce a trusted setup? (Y/N). If Y, justify and attach audit plan.
- Post-quantum migration plan included? (Y/N)
- Privacy regression tests added/updated? (Y/N)
- Threat model and ADR links updated? (Y/N)

If any answers are 'Y', attach the required artifacts or link follow-up issues before merge.
